_why: The studio will obey these literally. Every term below has exactly one meaning.

claim.state.means: Where a factual assertion stands. accepted = passed an AI-assisted passage check. proposed = found, not disposed.
claim.state.does_not_mean: accepted is NOT scholarly or human review. Nothing here has been checked by a qualified person.
claim.state.override: never — only an editor changes it

claim.speaker.means: This assertion is a character's statement, not the narrator's.
claim.speaker.does_not_mean: It does not mean the statement is false. It means it must be attributed wherever it is voiced.

gate.means: An operation that may not proceed until a named condition is met. Every gate names what it still allows.
gate.does_not_mean: A gate on one entity never blocks unrelated work, and no gate blocks writing.

lock.means: A visual decision held constant across every shot.
lock.does_not_mean: A lock is not a source claim. Most locks are artistic. Skin albedo locks are PROVISIONAL until sampled from an approved sheet.
lock.override: by a new approved sheet only

visual_interpretation.means: A detail the source does not specify, chosen by us and declared.
visual_interpretation.does_not_mean: It is never presented to a viewer as what the text says.

source_locator.means: Kāṇḍa, sarga and verse in the GRETIL numbering, or a Dutt section label. Each edition keeps its own numbering.
source_locator.does_not_mean: It is not an exact verse equivalence between editions. No global offset exists.

difference.means: Two sources disagree, recorded and unresolved.
difference.does_not_mean: It is not a verdict on which is right. Narration avoids asserting either.

never_rule.means: A thing that must not appear. Each is grounded in source, direction or policy.
never_rule.does_not_mean: A never-rule grounded only in taste must not override a sourced event. Where it did, it has been narrowed.
never_rule.override: direction-grounded rules may be refined by the director

shot_instruction.means: What the frame shows, how it is lensed, lit and moved.
shot_instruction.does_not_mean: It is not a guarantee a model will obey it.
shot_instruction.override: production may reframe; must not change what the shot asserts

reuse / crop.means: This shot comes from the named earlier shot. Nothing is generated.
reuse / crop.does_not_mean: It is not permission to repeat an expression that no longer matches. Re-check the face.
reuse / crop.override: production may promote to generate if the crop degrades

hold.means: A shot held on screen, still, for its full duration. The film keeps playing.
hold.does_not_mean: It is NOT a pause of the player, a freeze-frame effect, or a gap in the audio.
hold.override: CREATIVE-PROPOSAL. Proposed 8s in-app, 4s where a sentence is unfinished. The studio may change both.

share_cut.means: A standalone version for sending: entry signature, a connect line of minimum context, a shortened landing.
share_cut.does_not_mean: It must never drop attribution, qualification or cause. Shortening must not create false history.
share_cut.override: The INTEGRITY rules are fixed: never drop attribution, qualification or cause. The landing length (proposed 5s) is a CREATIVE-PROPOSAL the studio may change.

rhythm.means: A description of the house style.
rhythm.does_not_mean: NOT a constraint. Story determines duration.

seed.means: The generation seed, recorded for reproduction.
seed.does_not_mean: It does not carry identity — the sheet does. Seeds may repeat within a set-up.

_authority: See authority.json. A field defined here is not thereby mandatory.
